nodes.description: Align the whole input's analytic outline bounds to target at every exact evaluation time. Anchor [0,0] is top-left, [0.5,0.5] center, [1,1] bottom-right. Preserves child/glyph relationships in a wrapper; follows text/font/size changes. Coordinates are those of the input; a downstream object transform still applies. Excludes stroke, masks and effects; empty geometry passes through. Whole-content operation, not per-glyph alignment.

nodes.description: Sample the union of filled paths/text on a regular grid and return flat Points for Instance on Points. Applies upstream transforms, respects path holes; spacing and origin are in input coordinates. Each cell identity depends on grid coordinates, so retained cells keep identity after shape edits. Shape/spacing edits can add/remove cells; ordering is row-major. Ignores stroke paint; image effects/masks are unsupported. Outline flattening tolerance is 0.25 input pixels. Limits: 65536 candidate cells, 16384 occupied points.

nodes.description: Assign a stable random target inside transformed filled paths/text to every input point. Preserves point identity, velocity and other attributes. Connect before Solver initial: shape edits rebuild targets; animated shape motion after Solver start is not followed. Holes respect the fill rule. Strokes, effects and collisions are not sampled.

nodes.description: Prepare mipmapped, GPU-native textures while preserving the input. Bake/Rebuild runs in the background; Clear returns to the original. Auto preserves HDR as Float16; BC7 is a lossy SDR cache. Resolution is the longest edge, end is exclusive (0 means document end). Missing/stale/out-of-range bakes are explicit errors. Public worker command: fold.app.image-bake {document,node,group?}.

Optional group selects an internal graph. node merges inputs, settings, position and fold.motion.animation; id/kind/version stay stable. group merges a typed GroupDefinition; inputs have stable id, name, kind, default, unit, section, advanced. Inspect existing groups for complete examples. extract preserves the node ID as an instance; inspect that node settings.group to find its generated definition ID. Resources are omitted from inspection. All edits validate together. Datum is externally tagged: Scalar, Vector, Color, Bool, Text.
